rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Capped at 5%
rules.requirement: The Annual General Adjustment, the percentage by which a landlord of a fully-covered rental unit may raise rent each year, is capped at 5% even if the Rent Ordinance's CPI-based formula would otherwise produce a higher figure.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies only to fully-covered rental units (units with a rent ceiling). Measure BB also newly brought most government-owned/subsidized units (e.g., Section 8, Shelter Plus Care, LIHTC) into full or partial coverage, and narrowed the shared-kitchen/bath exemption to cases where the landlord resided on the property before the tenancy began.

rules.exemptions: Does not restrict a landlord's use of previously 'banked' (unused) AGAs from prior years to raise rent by more than 5% in a single year, up to the unit's rent ceiling.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.conflict_note: Document does not state the exact date this specific AGA cap took effect; 2024-12-20 is inferred from another Measure BB provision in the same document stated to apply 'for tenancies started on or after December 20, 2024' (Measure BB passed Nov. 2024).

rules.title: Capital Improvement Rent Increase Petitions Limited to Completed Work
rules.requirement: A landlord may petition the Rent Board for a rent increase based on capital improvements only after the improvements are completed; landlords can no longer obtain preliminary authorization to raise rent for planned, not-yet-completed capital improvements.
rules.quoted_span: Landlords can only file a petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements (they can no longer petition to have rent increases preliminarily authorized for planned capital improvements).
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not explicitly stated for this provision; inferred from Measure BB's general effective date referenced elsewhere in the document (Dec. 20, 2024).

rules.title: Minimum Rental Debt Threshold for Nonpayment-of-Rent Eviction
rules.requirement: A landlord may not evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent unless the tenant's rental debt equals or exceeds one month of the HUD Fair Market Rent (FMR) for a unit of equivalent size in the Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR area, as determined for the fiscal year the rent is demanded.
rules.key_value: 1 month's HUD Fair Market Rent (Oakland-Fremont, CA Metro FMR)

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not explicitly stated for this provision; inferred from Measure BB's general effective date referenced elsewhere in the document (Dec. 20, 2024).

rules.title: No Eviction for Refusing to Sign a New Fixed-Term Lease
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot evict a tenant solely for failing to sign a substantially similar replacement lease when a fixed-term lease expires.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not explicitly stated for this provision; inferred from Measure BB's general effective date referenced elsewhere in the document (Dec. 20, 2024).

rules.title: Heightened Standard for Lease-Violation Evictions
rules.requirement: To evict a tenant for breach of a material lease term, the term must have been mutually agreed upon, the violation must cause the landlord substantial actual harm, and the landlord must show the tenant's behavior was unreasonable; the landlord's prior notice to cure must specify the lease term and describe the violation and resulting harm in detail sufficient for a reasonable person to understand.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: The alleged violation must cause substantial, actual damage to the landlord.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not explicitly stated for this provision; inferred from Measure BB's general effective date referenced elsewhere in the document (Dec. 20, 2024).

rules.title: Eviction Notice Content and Rent Board Filing Deadline
rules.requirement: Any notice terminating a tenancy must tell the tenant that advice is available from the Rent Board and give the Rent Board's current phone number and website address. The landlord must file a copy of any termination notice, notice to quit, or summons and complaint with the Rent Board within three business days after it is served on the tenant.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after the tenant was served with the document.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not explicitly stated for this provision; inferred from Measure BB's general effective date referenced elsewhere in the document (Dec. 20, 2024).

rules.title: Mandatory Annual Adjustment of Owner Move-In Relocation Assistance
rules.requirement: The Rent Board must make an inflationary adjustment each year to the relocation assistance payments owed to tenants evicted so the owner (or qualified relative) can move in.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to owner move-in evictions of tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date not explicitly stated for this provision; inferred from Measure BB's general effective date referenced elsewhere in the document (Dec. 20, 2024). No specific dollar amount or formula for the relocation payments is given in this document.
